content.text: Error Domain=mcpbridge Code=1 "The background MCP server (XcodeService) call to XcodeListWorkspaces failed: This agent isn't approved to use Xcode's tools yet. Call XcodeOpenWorkspace or XcodeNewProject first: opening or creating a project is what asks the user to approve this agent, together with access to that project's folder.. Run `xcrun mcp-server status` to check it, then retry."
